drinks_description_length_chk.name: drinks_description_length_chk
drinks_description_length_chk.value: "drinks"."description" IS NULL OR char_length("drinks"."description") BETWEEN 1 AND 280

events_location_name_length_chk.name: events_location_name_length_chk
events_location_name_length_chk.value: "events"."location_name" IS NULL OR char_length("events"."location_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 120

events_location_address_length_chk.name: events_location_address_length_chk
events_location_address_length_chk.value: "events"."location_address" IS NULL OR char_length("events"."location_address") BETWEEN 1 AND 300

events_location_maps_url_chk.name: events_location_maps_url_chk
events_location_maps_url_chk.value: "events"."location_maps_url" IS NULL OR (char_length("events"."location_maps_url") BETWEEN 1 AND 2048 AND "events"."location_maps_url" LIKE 'https://%')

events_location_notes_length_chk.name: events_location_notes_length_chk
events_location_notes_length_chk.value: "events"."location_notes" IS NULL OR char_length("events"."location_notes") BETWEEN 1 AND 1000

events_location_confirmation_complete_ch.name: events_location_confirmation_complete_chk
events_location_confirmation_complete_ch.value: "events"."location_status" <> 'CONFIRMED' OR "events"."location_address" IS NOT NULL OR "events"."location_maps_url" IS NOT NULL

guest_consumptions_source_reference_chk.name: guest_consumptions_source_reference_chk
guest_consumptions_source_reference_chk.value: ("guest_consumptions"."drink_id" IS NULL OR "guest_consumptions"."source" = 'DRINK') AND ("guest_consumptions"."extra_id" IS NULL OR "guest_consumptions"."source" = 'EXTRA')

guest_consumptions_voided_pair_chk.name: guest_consumptions_voided_pair_chk
guest_consumptions_voided_pair_chk.value: "guest_consumptions"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL OR "guest_consumptions"."voided_by" IS NULL

messages_delivery_contact_chk.name: messages_delivery_contact_chk
messages_delivery_contact_chk.value: "messages"."status" NOT IN ('WAITING_WINDOW', 'QUEUED', 'SENT', 'READ') OR "messages"."contact_id" IS NOT NULL

messages_sent_timestamp_chk.name: messages_sent_timestamp_chk
messages_sent_timestamp_chk.value: "messages"."status" NOT IN ('SENT', 'READ', 'SENT_MANUALLY') OR "messages"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL

messages_body_length_chk.name: messages_body_length_chk
messages_body_length_chk.value: "messages"."body" IS NULL OR char_length("messages"."body") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000

messages_attachment_urls_chk.name: messages_attachment_urls_chk
messages_attachment_urls_chk.value: "messages"."attachment_urls" IS NULL OR cardinality("messages"."attachment_urls") BETWEEN 1 AND 10

messages_content_chk.name: messages_content_chk
messages_content_chk.value: "messages"."body" IS NOT NULL OR "messages"."attachment_urls" IS NOT NULL

payment_settings_payment_link_chk.name: payment_settings_payment_link_chk
payment_settings_payment_link_chk.value: "payment_settings"."payment_link" IS NULL OR (char_length("payment_settings"."payment_link") BETWEEN 1 AND 300 AND ("payment_settings"."payment_link" !~* '^http' OR "payment_settings"."payment_link" ~* '^https://'))

reservations_guest2_party_chk.name: reservations_guest2_party_chk
reservations_guest2_party_chk.value: "reservations"."guest2_full_name" IS NULL OR ("reservations"."party_size" = 2 AND char_length("reservations"."guest2_full_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 120)

reservations_guest2_contact_requires_gue.name: reservations_guest2_contact_requires_guest2_chk
reservations_guest2_contact_requires_gue.value: "reservations"."guest2_contact_id" IS NULL OR "reservations"."guest2_full_name" IS NOT NULL

reservations_guest2_contact_distinct_chk.name: reservations_guest2_contact_distinct_chk
reservations_guest2_contact_distinct_chk.value: "reservations"."guest2_contact_id" IS NULL OR "reservations"."guest2_contact_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "reservations"."contact_id"

reservations_refund_status_chk.name: reservations_refund_status_chk
reservations_refund_status_chk.value: "reservations"."refund_status" IS NULL OR ("reservations"."refund_status" IN ('PENDING', 'REFUNDED') AND "reservations"."status" = 'CANCELLED' AND "reservations"."stage" = 'PAID')

reservations_refunded_timestamp_chk.name: reservations_refunded_timestamp_chk
reservations_refunded_timestamp_chk.value: "reservations"."refund_status" IS DISTINCT FROM 'REFUNDED' OR "reservations"."refunded_at" IS NOT NULL

reservations_allergies_length_chk.name: reservations_allergies_length_chk
reservations_allergies_length_chk.value: "reservations"."allergies" IS NULL OR char_length("reservations"."allergies") BETWEEN 1 AND 300

reservations_confirmed_fields_chk.name: reservations_confirmed_fields_chk
reservations_confirmed_fields_chk.value: "reservations"."status" <> 'CONFIRMED' OR ("reservations"."reservation_number" IS NOT NULL AND "reservations"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL)

reservations_full_rejected_fields_chk.name: reservations_full_rejected_fields_chk
reservations_full_rejected_fields_chk.value: "reservations"."status" <> 'FULL_REJECTED' OR ("reservations"."reservation_number" IS NULL AND "reservations"."accepted_at" IS NULL)

waitlist_entries_guest2_party_chk.name: waitlist_entries_guest2_party_chk
waitlist_entries_guest2_party_chk.value: "waitlist_entries"."guest2_full_name" IS NULL OR ("waitlist_entries"."party_size" = 2 AND char_length("waitlist_entries"."guest2_full_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 120)

waitlist_entries_promoted_fields_chk.name: waitlist_entries_promoted_fields_chk
waitlist_entries_promoted_fields_chk.value: "waitlist_entries"."status" <> 'PROMOTED' OR ("waitlist_entries"."promoted_reservation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "waitlist_entries"."promoted_at" IS NOT NULL)
